hebrewText: כִּ֤י כָל רֹאשׁ֙ קָרְחָ֔ה וְ/כָל זָקָ֖ן גְּרֻעָ֑ה עַ֤ל כָּל יָדַ֨יִם֙ גְּדֻדֹ֔ת וְ/עַל מָתְנַ֖יִם שָֽׂק

tokens.bdb: properly, the waist or small of the back; only in plural the loins
properly, a mesh (as allowing a liquid to run through), i.e. coarse loose cloth or sacking (used in mourning and for bagging); hence, a bag (for grain, etc.)
